payload.core_composition_summary: Solution enumerates each node as initial target (complete search), then greedily collects a maximal contiguous sequence by sweeping backward then forward from that node.
payload.rationale: Outer loop exhaustively tries every node as the first to reach; inner logic applies a fixed greedy path (backward to 0 then forward) without further search, combining enumeration with greedy construction.
